mappings.summary: Use Select for a simple non-searchable field, Combobox for searchable or multiple behavior, and NativeSelect only when native DOM semantics are explicitly wanted; the facade must preserve the legacy option model and value-only callbacks.

propMappings.summary: Transform the data array into items/options using labelKey and valueKey.
Resolve legacy scalar value(s) against options by valueKey when the Base UI target uses option objects; preserve scalar values only for a target built from scalar items.
Convert selected option object(s) back to legacy scalar value(s) through valueKey, then call the value-only callback and discard primitive event details.
Call the legacy text-only search callback when the Combobox input value changes.
This is documented, but the current InputSelect runtime never calls it and always renders item[labelKey]; decide whether the facade restores the documented renderer.
Invoke the render function for the Combobox empty-state content.
Preserve the legacy selected-value placeholder separately from the editable search input, which uses a blank placeholder while the overlay is active.
Use Base UI multiple selection for the Combobox path or native multiple selection when NativeSelect is deliberately chosen; shadcn Select remains single-value.
Apply the disabled state to whichever target the usage audit selects.
Preserve preview-only selection behavior on the selected Base UI target; native select has no readOnly attribute and needs wrapper-level enforcement.
Legacy required suppresses the reset control but is not forwarded to the input; decide whether the facade preserves that behavior or restores the documented native required constraint.
Replace the trigger chevron with a loading indicator while options are loading.
The runtime toggles an editable search input; for migration it also decides whether Select or Combobox is the appropriate target.
Build a filter that searches labelKey plus each configured object field.
Use the configured field for item labels and selected-value display.
Use the configured field for form serialization and stable object comparison; itemToStringValue alone does not convert the controlled value shape.
Wrap the one-argument legacy predicate in the Combobox filter signature; legacy runs it only after text search.
Although deprecated, this value is still active and takes precedence over renderEmptyState at runtime.
Render the legacy icon before both the editable input and selected-value display.
Translate true/false to top/bottom on the selected popup target; NativeSelect has no floating side.
Preserve the active internal Field behavior that merges parent disabled and error state.
Expose the visual error state through aria-invalid and Applique error styling.
The runtime defaults this nominally required prop to bordered and applies bordered/standard classes; approve the registry class target and tokens.
Render arbitrary adornment content around the Combobox input.
Preserve the undocumented-but-active start/end placement, whose runtime default is end.
BaseProps permits className, but the current InputSelect implementation does not forward it; choose an intentional facade class target.
The current InputSelect drops style; choose whether to preserve that no-op or apply it to the composed field root.
The current InputSelect drops a client id and generates internal ids; define whether the facade id belongs on the input, trigger, or composed field root.

mappings.summary: Choose Item for display, Command for command-style keyboard navigation, RadioGroup for one selected value, or Checkbox composition for multiple values; no one target preserves the full legacy list.

propMappings.summary: Map the legacy data array into the chosen target's item children.
Invoke the per-item render function with index, id, and item.
The target depends on usage: RadioGroup owns a scalar value, while multiple selection needs individually controlled Checkboxes.
Adapt to RadioGroup onValueChange, Checkbox onCheckedChange, or CommandItem onSelect only after the selection intent is known.
Use the accessor for stable keys, item values, and selected-value comparisons.
Evaluate the predicate for every rendered target item.
This changes value shape, enables select-all, and usually decides between RadioGroup and a Checkbox composition.
VirtualList is active legacy behavior; none of the shortlisted registry wrappers replaces it directly, so retain a virtualization layer or approve its removal per usage.
The chosen display, command, or selection root determines where the legacy list class belongs.
The legacy renderContainer overwrites a caller style with its layout style; decide whether the facade preserves that bug or restores an intentional root style target.
The legacy id lands on the listbox, but the chosen registry target determines whether it belongs on ItemGroup, CommandList, or a selection-group root.

mappings.summary: Use Spinner for the legacy spinner appearance and an indeterminate Progress composition for the bar appearance; preserve the runtime differences around isLoading instead of treating Loader as measurable progress.

propMappings.summary: inline, small, and large control both size and surrounding layout; map them only after choosing Spinner or Progress and approving equivalent dimensions.
The prop is documented but ignored by the current Loader runtime; decide whether the facade should restore the intended currentColor behavior.
Select Spinner or an indeterminate Progress rendering from the legacy appearance.
Legacy bar animation stops when false, but legacy spinner animation does not; choose whether compatibility preserves this inconsistency or normalizes both.
Render the visible loading text beside the selected indicator.

Keep className on the outer loader wrapper rather than moving it onto only the indicator.

mappings.summary: Use Dialog for the desktop modal, Drawer for the mobile drawer, Sheet for the side drawer, and AlertDialog only when call-site intent is a confirmation; runtime supports SIDE_DRAWER even though the public type and generated docs omit it.

propMappings.summary: Preserve string-trigger button creation and clone/custom-trigger activation in the chosen compound overlay.
Rename the controlled legacy state to open on the selected overlay root.
Invert the legacy hide flag; Drawer needs an explicitly composed close control.
Compose the selected root's state callback and invoke onOpen only for an internal transition to open; external isOpen prop changes must not call it.
Call the custom layout renderer with title, actions, children, onClose, and type.
Render the title in the selected overlay's accessible title component.
Render action nodes in the footer and preserve the function form that receives the close callback.
Invert the flag for pointer dismissal and inspect close reasons so Escape does not introduce an undocumented close path when strict legacy behavior is required.
Compose the selected root's state callback and invoke onClose only for an accepted internal close transition.
Select the overlay composition; SIDE_DRAWER is active runtime behavior missing from the declared public union.
Render body content in the selected overlay content component.
Keep className on the outer modal wrapper that contains both backdrop and body, matching the legacy target.
Apply the inline style to the outer modal wrapper, where legacy remaining props are spread.
Apply the id to the outer modal wrapper rather than silently moving it to only the dialog body.

mappings.summary: Use Progress for the numeric bar and a custom Progress/SVG composition for the numeric circle. Spinner remains only a usage-review alternative for call sites that used Progress as an indeterminate loader and do not rely on its numeric contract.

Send the numeric completion value to the Progress root for bars or to the custom determinate SVG calculation for circles.
Conditionally render the percentage label for both bar and circle presentations.
success, info, warning, and danger are active semantic colors; approve their token classes on ProgressIndicator and the custom circle stroke.

small, medium, and large change bar height or circle diameter by different legacy scales; approve separate mappings before implementation.

Apply className to the selected bar/circle root; an explicitly approved Spinner alternative keeps it on the surrounding compatibility wrapper.

Preserve the legacy root id on the selected determinate root or approved compatibility wrapper.
